newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume drops on rising prices.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume drops on rising prices.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange volume fell sharply to 815 kilos on Tuesday, from Monday's 1,674 kilos, as rising prices stemmed demand saturated by heavy buying on Monday, dealers said.
Gold firmed in line with the world trends to close at $348.00 an ounce and 1,360,000 lira per gram, compared to $345.90 and 1,343,800 lira on Monday.
A weaker lira also helped prices to firm in lira terms. The lira eased to 121,100 lira to the dollar from 120,810 on Monday despite minor central bank intervention.
Most of the day's trade -- 535 kilos -- was conducted in the morning session and 74.2 percent of total turnover was in lira terms.
